summary: Requested a repeat execution of the fixed verify experiment d704b04e706144dc964ff451359eda19-experiment, because its cited receipt (b02d5ff23a504a8ea38116085ba8e23c) carries the recorded limitation that repeatability of its timing-sensitive control is unestablished. The re-run uses the retained fixed inputs in a clean copy, so the new receipt can be compared with the first on the same three partitions: whether the non-voter-only partition still returns success, whether the voter-only control still succeeds, whether the no-peer partition still fails, and how the lease-driven step-down timing compares. Nothing is claimed about the outcome until that receipt exists; the current interpretations and knowledge are unchanged. Source reads made this turn found no defect to register: the Restore path's commit-ahead behaviour is explicitly documented as disaster-recovery-only, and replication falls back to sending a snapshot on ErrLogNotFound, so a lagging follower is not fed stale or hole-crossing log entries.
